title: SciView project file, format 1.x
description: A SciView film (.sciview.json). Paths are relative to the file. Times are seconds from the start of the object's scene. Readers keep what they do not know.

width.description: Pixels. Layout is in these units; usual range 16..7680

duration.description: Seconds. With several scenes this is their total; set the length of each scene instead; usual range 0.1..3600

bloom.description: Strength of the glow; usual range 0..3

font.description: Poppins, Inter, or a path to a .ttf/.otf file

theme.description: Name of the theme last applied

logo.description: Shown on top of the film (PNG with transparency); a path relative to the project file, or a pattern such as assets/run/*.csv

audio.description: Narration or music mixed into the export; a path relative to the project file, or a pattern such as assets/run/*.csv

audio_offset.description: Seconds into the film where the audio starts

crop_x.description: Horizontal centre of square and vertical exports, in pixels (-1 = the middle); usual range -1..

azimuth.description: Degrees around the vertical axis; usual range -720..720

elevation.description: Degrees above the floor; usual range -89..89

fov.description: Field of view in degrees; usual range 1..150

offset.description: Shift the 3D scene on screen, in pixels
